title: VaultIndex
description: The shelf and the ledger of a project's vault (ADR 0049). Editions are not listed: they are the notebooks that carry an `edition` date.

project_id.title: ProjectId
project_id.description: Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry.

shelf.description: The top-level notebooks in the order to read them, the fundamentals first. Everything else is reached by embedding.

items.title: VaultNoteId
items.description: A note's identifier, unique within a project: kebab-case words that say what the note is (`macro-tokenizer`, not `note-12`). It is what `[[id]]` links and `![[id]]` embeds name, so it does not change.

bottom_line.description: Two or three sentences: where the project stands today.

order.description: The claims, most important first. Claims left out follow in id order.

items.title: VaultNoteId
items.description: A note's identifier, unique within a project: kebab-case words that say what the note is (`macro-tokenizer`, not `note-12`). It is what `[[id]]` links and `![[id]]` embeds name, so it does not change.

updated_at.title: Timestamp
updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

updated_by.title: ResearchActor
updated_by.description: Who made a change: a human session, an agent token or the system. Work under a task links the task (`task:ID`).
